visual.name: mapTale
visual.description: MapTale by DataTale: a project map for Power BI, all in one visual. Boundary layers with labels, click-to-filter and shade-by-data, greyscale-to-imagery zoom, clustering, status-coloured category icons, project popups with photo carousels, in-map header with slicers and search, legend, stats and 3D buildings. No map accounts, API keys, per-user licences or usage fees.

dataRoles.name: id
dataRoles.description: A column that uniquely identifies each row. Drives selection and cross-filtering.

dataRoles.name: latitude
dataRoles.description: Decimal latitude of each marker.

dataRoles.name: longitude
dataRoles.description: Decimal longitude of each marker.

dataRoles.name: category
dataRoles.description: Its values become the marker icons, the filter buttons, the legend rows, the chart bars and the Category dropdown.

dataRoles.name: status
dataRoles.description: Each value gets a colour (Format > Status colours) on the markers, popup, legend and stats card, and feeds the Status dropdown.

dataRoles.name: boundary1
dataRoles.description: Column whose values match the names in boundary layer 1. Clicking a shape, or picking it in the header, filters on this column.

dataRoles.name: boundary2
dataRoles.description: Column whose values match the names in boundary layer 2.

dataRoles.name: boundary3
dataRoles.description: Column whose values match the names in boundary layer 3.

dataRoles.name: title
dataRoles.description: Popup heading; also what the header search box searches.

dataRoles.name: description
dataRoles.description: Text shown in the popup under the status.

dataRoles.name: completionDate
dataRoles.description: A date row in the popup, for example a completion or inspection date. The row label is this field's name.

dataRoles.name: photoUrl
dataRoles.description: One https image URL, or several separated by | for a carousel.

dataRoles.name: photoOrientation
dataRoles.description: landscape or portrait (pipe-separated per photo when using a carousel).

dataRoles.name: currentYearFunds
dataRoles.description: A row in the popup. The row label is this field's name; shown as money only when the field is money (a currency format, or a name such as cost or funds).

dataRoles.name: futureYearFunds
dataRoles.description: A second row in the popup. The row label is this field's name; shown as money only when the field is money.

dataRoles.name: budget
dataRoles.description: A number totalled per category (info-panel chart) and per area (stats card), shown in the popup, and able to colour areas (Format > Areas). Money only when the field is money.

dataRoles.name: budgetBand
dataRoles.description: A column for the header's Filter dropdown, for example a budget band or a council. Money bands sort by amount.

dataRoles.name: updatedOn
dataRoles.description: Date or text for the legend footer, for example the data refresh date.

dataRoles.name: tooltips
dataRoles.description: Any fields for the hover tooltip.

dataRoles.name: gridValue
dataRoles.description: Grid map style: the number each square is coloured by (for example an intensity), summarised per square as set in Format > Grid.

dataRoles.name: gridCount
dataRoles.description: Grid map style: how many things a row stands for (for example felt reports per cell). Used for the square's count, the tooltip and 'Hide squares with fewer than'. Blank = 1 per row.

dataRoles.name: gridSize
dataRoles.description: Grid map style, when each row already is a square: its size in km. Rows of several sizes switch by zoom, like the Geoscience Australia felt-report map.

dataRoles.name: heatWeight
dataRoles.description: Heat map style: how much each row adds to the heat (for example people injured). Blank = every row counts once.
